exposure: GDM by WHO 2013 but not by WHO-1999
Mild gestational diabetes (GDM) (diagnosed by WHO 2013 criteria but not by WHO-1999 criteria)
cohort: 336 pregnant women with 'mild' GDM and 3303 pregnant women with normal glucose tolerance (NGT) in Hungary
finding: While pregnancy outcomes were worse for women with 'mild' GDM compared to NGT women, these differences were largely explained by differences in pre-pregnancy BMI.
mod_finding: While 'mild' GDM was associated with higher rates of induced/instrumental delivery and acute cesarean section, these differences were largely explained by pre-pregnancy BMI.
